title: NovoTech Semi-Automatic Band Saws — Hydraulic Bandsaws | Canada
meta_description: NovoTech semi-automatic metal cutting band saws (hydraulic bandsaws) for sale in Canada: the full-hydraulic BS-315GF double-miter saw, BS-460G dual-miter, BS-2114TH, BS-5030 single-column and the 18″ BS-650GA. Specs in inches and mm.
intro: Hydraulic saws for the production floor at value-line prices, led by our best seller — the BS-315GF, a 10-inch double-miter (mitre) saw with hydraulic vise, hydraulic down-feed and hydraulic bow up-lift. A hydraulic cylinder lowers the bow at a dialled-in rate, the bow lifts and the machine stops at the end of the cut. From the 10-inch saws to the 18-inch BS-650GA swivel-head saw, with a single-column touch-screen model (BS-5030) in between. If you are looking for a semi-automatic metal bandsaw, a hydraulic horizontal band saw for metal or an industrial band saw machine with a hydraulic vise, this is the page.

faq_title: Questions we get asked about NovoTech semi-automatic band saws

faq.q: What is the difference between a semi-automatic and a fully automatic band saw?
faq.a: A semi-automatic saw makes one cut per start: it clamps, cuts and lifts the bow, then waits for the operator to feed the next piece. A fully automatic saw also feeds the material to length and repeats the cycle for the programmed quantity — see the value line automatic band saws.

faq.q: Which value-line saws cut miters on both sides?
faq.a: The BS-315GF, BS-460G / 460G-JC and BS-650GA swivel to both sides (45° left and right, 60° right); the BS-2114TH cuts angles up to 60° on one side.

faq.q: What does "full-hydraulic" mean on the BS-315GF?
faq.a: Hydraulic vise, hydraulic down-feed and hydraulic bow up-lift on one 10-inch machine: the operator loads the bar, presses start and the saw clamps, cuts, lifts the bow and switches off. The gear drive and a bow that swivels to both sides with fast stops at 30°, 45° and 60° complete it.

Single column: the BS-5030 guides the bow vertically on a column instead of a pivot, for square straight cuts up to Ø11-3/4″ / 19-3/4″ × 11-3/4″ with a PLC touch screen. Its automatic sister is the BS-5040.

faq.q: What voltage do these saws run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V with a CSA-approved electrical panel; 208 V, 240 V or 480 V 3-phase are available on request.
